slot.brief: Which class does a named drug belong to (e.g. equanil/veronal – tranquilizer; aspirin – analgesic)?

stem: Ampicillin belongs to which class of drugs?
working:
Ampicillin is a penicillin-class antibiotic.

Independent check: Ampicillin is a penicillin-class antibiotic.
solution: Ampicillin is a penicillin-class drug used to treat bacterial infections; hence, it is an antibiotic.
